mapper.update: UPDATE user_report_credibility SET total_reports = total_reports + 1, valid_reports = valid_reports + 1, credibility_score = LEAST(100, credibility_score + #{increment,jdbcType=INTEGER}), last_report_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND deleted = 1

UPDATE user_report_credibility SET total_reports = total_reports + 1, invalid_reports = invalid_reports + 1, credibility_score = GREATEST(0, credibility_score - #{decrement,jdbcType=INTEGER}), last_report_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND deleted = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_report_credibility (user_id, credibility_score, total_reports, valid_reports, invalid_reports, create_time) VALUES (#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 100, 0, 0, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN credibility_score >= 80 THEN 'high' WHEN credibility_score >= 50 THEN 'medium' WHEN credibility_score >= 30 THEN 'low' ELSE 'very_low' END AS level, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user_report_credibility WHERE deleted = 1 GROUP BY level ORDER BY CASE level WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

SELECT
FROM user_report_credibility WHERE total_reports > 0 AND deleted = 1 ORDER BY total_reports DESC, valid_reports DESC LIMIT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}
